FDA suspends licences of Café Mondegar and three other Mumbai eateries over safety violations

The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) suspended the operating licences of Café Mondegar in Mumbai and three additional food outlets. The FDA’s inspection report cited violations of food safety standards and inadequate cleanliness at the establishments. The action was reported by multiple Indian news outlets in both English and Hindi. One of the affected outlets, Maharashtra Biryani Center, was specifically named in Hindi‑language reports. The licences were either suspended or cancelled, indicating the FDA’s enforcement response. No further legal proceedings or appeals were mentioned in the coverage.
